tagline: A leading provider of advanced optical, industrial, and automotive manufacturing services
hero_kpi_rationale: Fabrinet is exposed to the AI wave through its position in advanced optical systems for datacenters (HPC/Cloud), a strategic segment for photonic equipment customers

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total value of sales realized by the company.
kpis.description: Revenue has grown driven by strong demand in optical communications and automotive markets.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth sustained by demand in optics and industrial lasers.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue that remains after deduction of direct production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin is influenced by dominant material costs and wage pressures in Asia.
kpis.signal: Moderate gross margin typical of low-margin electronics manufacturing activities.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit generated before exceptional items, reported as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is progressing slowly despite wage cost pressures.
kpis.signal: Operating margin showing slight improvement driven by process optimization.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending to acquire or improve physical assets such as factories or equipment.
kpis.description: The company plans to increase investments to meet future demand.
kpis.signal: CAPEX increasing to expand manufacturing capacity in Asia.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees employed by the company.
kpis.description: Headcount is increasing to support growth in production volumes.
kpis.signal: Headcount growth driven by expansion in Thailand and China.

kpis.name: Customer Concentration
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue generated by the two largest customers.
kpis.description: The share of the two largest customers is declining slightly, reducing dependency risk.
kpis.signal: Reduction in dependency on the two largest customers, a sign of diversification.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €2.83 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.01 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Revenue outside North America
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue generated outside North America.
kpis.description: The share of revenue outside North America declined in 2025 (63.5% in FY2024 to 56.6% in FY2025) due to increased North American revenues. Based on short and medium-term customer indications, the company expects an increase in the portion of future revenues attributable to customers outside North America compared to FY2025.
kpis.signal: Decline of 6.9 percentage points in 2025 due to increased North American revenues. However, management expects future increases in regions outside North America based on short and medium-term customer indications.

risks.title: Customer Concentration Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on a few customers, which can lead to revenue loss if any of these customers reduce orders or default.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the precision manufacturing services market is high, which can lead to market share loss and price reduction.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risks due to dependence on a few key customers and the possibility of payment default.

risks.title: Component Shortages
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to component shortage risks due to dependence on a few key suppliers and the complexity of the supply chain.

risks.title: Market Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to market fluctuation risks due to dependence on the optical communications industry and market volatility.

risks.title: Limited Diversification
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to limited diversification risks due to its dependence on the optical communications industry and difficulty penetrating new markets.

risks.title: Order Cancellations
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to order cancellation risks due to the volatile nature of the market and the possibility of changes in customer needs.

ai_positioning.summary: Fabrinet does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related subjects in its 10-K/20-F report.
